displayName: Usage & Conversations Monitor for Claude Code
description: Live Claude subscription limits, token usage and the state of your Claude Code conversations, right in the status bar.
config.claudeConfigDir: Claude Code config directory. Empty = `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` or `~/.claude`.
config.planUsage.enabled: Show subscription limits (5-hour session and weekly). Uses the OAuth login stored by Claude Code; the token is only sent to `api.anthropic.com`.
config.planUsage.refreshSeconds: How often subscription limits are refreshed, in seconds (shared across windows).
config.sessions.scope: Which Claude Code conversations to show.
config.sessions.scope.all: Every conversation open in any VS Code window.
config.sessions.scope.workspace: Only conversations of the folders open in this window.
config.notifications.onWaiting: Notify when a conversation of this window needs an answer or a permission.
config.notifications.onDone: Notify when a conversation of this window finishes its turn.
config.warningThreshold: Usage percentage from which the status bar turns to warning color (red at 95%).
